scripts.setup: uv sync && cd web && bun install
scripts.test: uv run pytest -q api/tests && cd web && bun run unit && cd .. && bun test scripts
scripts.typecheck: cd web && bun run typecheck && cd .. && uv run mypy
scripts.screenshots: bun run build && cd web && SCREENSHOTS=1 CI=1 E2E_PORT=8767 bunx playwright test e2e/screenshots.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:live: cd web && BASE_URL=${BASE_URL:-https://venturetaste.5-78-152-178.sslip.io} bunx playwright test e2e/live.spec.ts
scripts.demo:frames: mkdir -p out/frames && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/venturetaste-demo.mp4 -vf fps=1/20,scale=1280:-1 out/frames/f%02d.png
scripts.e2e: bun run build && cd web && bun run e2e
scripts.start:fixtures: VENTURETASTE_FIXTURES=1 VENTURETASTE_LLM=off VENTURETASTE_RATE_LIMIT=100000 uv run uvicorn api.main:app --port 8766
scripts.dev: uv run uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8765 & cd web && bun run dev
